integrity: The theorem has a complete symbolic argument. Finite enumerations are checks, not proofs of the unlimited quantifiers. Historical-priority uncertainty remains, and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only linear binary words with exactly five nonempty alternating runs; no exact finite-n extremizer classification; no bound for more runs; count includes the empty factor.
title: Exact closed-factor census and sharp quadratic density for five-run binary words
